description: Use when the user asks what offers they have resting on the XP marketplace, or what they are waiting on -- 'what offers do I have out for tickets to that show?'. An open offer buys at the user's price whenever a matching fan listing appears, without them watching for it. Live offers only -- filled ones have become tickets (`get_my_tickets`) and rescinded ones are history; both stay reachable by id through `get_open_offer`. Requires auth.
name: list_my_open_offers
title: My Open Offers
